query:
UPDATE mail_accounts
            SET
                name = $3,
                host = $4,
                port = $5,
                username = $6,
                password_enc = $7,
                tls_mode = $8,
                is_enabled = $9,
                last_error = $10,
                last_connected_at = $11,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
